title: Near-Duplicate Input
summary: Spots near-duplicates of existing names as you type, so a second "Marketing" tag or folder isn't created by accident.
description: Create field that spots near-duplicates as you type (capitals, spacing, punctuation, plurals, one-letter typos, never different numbers like Q3 vs Q4) and offers Use existing, which is also what Enter does.
catches: Same name in different capitals or spacing
Leaves different numbers alone (Q3 vs Q4)
limits: Compares against the items you pass; it doesn't search your database
a11y: Visible label; input is described by a polite hint region
Enter picks the existing item when a near-duplicate is shown
Use existing button's aria-label names the item; create shows aria-busy while pending
